text:
Denton Mateychuk is 22 and playing 22 and a half minutes a night for Columbus, which tells you how the Blue Jackets feel about him. He's answered with four goals in 15 games, including goals in three straight in late October.

The goals are running ahead of the chances (four on 2.2 expected, the quality of his chances), so don't expect that pace. What's encouraging is the rest: Columbus has 52% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, about six points better than without him, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting to the slot more than almost any defenseman last season (95th percentile).

Evolving-Hockey thought he was unlucky in 2025-26, with 3.2 expected wins against 1.2 actual. He was the 12th pick in 2022, and the closest comparable picks in our draft history include Zeev Buium and Noah Dobson. His ice time dipped by two minutes over the last ten, which we'd keep an eye on. Our projection: about 13 goals and 38 points.
